LORNA VILLARUZ YOUR NMC PIN IS HERE!!! 🎉🎉🎉 @Lorna Villaruz my bestfriend, my sister from another mother, finally officially a registered nurse in the UK!! Thank you Lord!!! I have been trying to write this properly but I am too excited, you know me, more exclamation marks than words today 😂❤️

From nursing school in Iloilo, our capping ceremony in 1996, to this!! Thirty years, Lorna. Look at us!! Same friendship, probably still thinking we look like those girls in the photo haha. I remember us polishing our white shoes every night in the dorm, and YOU always borrowing my shoe polish. Every night!! Never buying your own!! Now you have your UK PIN, perhaps finally you can afford your own polish 😂😂 Love you, don't get angry.

When I left for the UK in 2004 you cried at the airport and told me “susunod ako”, I will follow you. Well you took your time madam!!! I have been telling you come to Liverpool for more than 20 years, and now at last I can stop nagging you about that. Don't worry, I will find something else to nag you about haha.

After Riyadh and Dubai, almost 18 years working so hard, next stop LIVERPOOL!! She lands in Manchester on 14 January 2027, then starts work on 25 January, so January cannot come quickly enough in this house 🎉 Ward 7, you are so lucky to have her. Honestly, she is the best nurse I know. So calm, so caring, and the patients love her. That lovely way you have with people, Lorna, that is something very special. I am so proud of you and so happy we will finally be near each other again.

The spare room is waiting for you for your first month with us!! Ben says yes, all approved haha. Thick duvet and heater ready because I know you will freeze. When you went to Nottingham for your OSCE I sent you a photo of the rain, just so nobody can say I didn't warn you 😂 Please bring a PROPER COAT. Not a little cardigan and positive thinking. Liverpool wind does not care that you have come from Dubai!!

And welcome to our Filipino family here, my friend ❤️ There will be food, plenty of advice whether you ask for it or not, and our Christmas parties to look forward to. Next year, Simbang Gabi together with us!! After all these years of saying “one day”, we can finally make actual plans.

Mga kabayan, help me give Lorna the biggest welcome!! My forever partner in crime is coming to Liverpool!!! Congratulations my bestfriend. Bring yourself, bring that proper coat, and don't forget the dried mangoes 😂❤️🙏🎉
